messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Added the **Deal name** input. Named saves export as version 2 and restore the name on import; unnamed saves and replay output remain version 1. Names clear on New Game, Restart, size changes, board loads, and unnamed imports. See [Reproduction.tsx](/work/src/game/controls/Reproduction.tsx:43) and [snapshot.ts](/work/src/game/snapshot.ts:14).

Fixed pasted saves with reordered JSON properties. The loader now checks the exact required keys without requiring a particular order, while still rejecting unknown keys. Regression coverage is in [snapshot-name.test.ts](/work/src/game/snapshot-name.test.ts:17) and [snapshots.e2e.test.ts](/work/tests/snapshots.e2e.test.ts:98).

**Checks:** typecheck passed; all 144 unit tests and 78 browser tests passed, including the fresh build. Changed files pass Prettier. The project-wide format check still reports issues in 12 unchanged files: existing docs, `scripts/replay.test.ts`, and two browser tests.
